explanation: A prophet in Israel who performed miracles and conveyed God's message to the people.
The time period of a famine that Elisha predicted and warned about.
A woman who helped Elisha and received a promise that she would have a son.
The ruler over Israel whom Elisha contacted and influenced through his prophecies.
An officer in the Aramean army who was anointed by Elisha to become king over Aram.
King of Aram whom Hazael killed to take the throne.
King of Israel who was wounded in battle and succeeded by his brother Ahaziah.
King of Judah who ruled together with his mother Athaliah after his father's death.
The queen mother who killed all her grandchildren to keep power, but was eventually killed.
A grandson of Athaliah who survived and became king of Judah at seven years old.
